context: 6 Details of the algorithm The streaming implementation in the turnstile model will make use of the Count Sketch algorithm of Charikar, Chen, and Farach-Colton [14]. It is easy to adapt their algorithm for the purpose of finding supp(f ). This gives us the following theorem. I Theorem 9 (Charikar, Chen, Farach-Colton [14]). Suppose that S is a stream with at most s items of nonzero frequency. There is a turnstile streaming algorithm Count Sketch(S, s, δ) using O(s log nδ log M ) bits that, with probability at least 1 − δ, returns all of the nonzero frequencies in S.
